t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are two groups of gnomes differnt colours and you should keep chooseing the same basket if the last basket you picked was above 3

vb_textbox.text: There are two different colours of baskets in the forest, different gnomes take you to different baskets: red basket (gnomes that lead to red: red, pink, purple and brown)Yellow basket (gnomes that lead to yellow: yellow, green, blue and orange)When you tap on a gnome it will take you to a forest with a different coloured basket (red or Yellow), if that basket give you less than 4 mushrooms then make sure you pick a gnome that will take you to the other colour of basket. If it gives you more than 5 mushrooms stick with that same basket colour by picking a gnome from that colour group, because the next go you will get more points.So the general rule is: if you pick a pink gnome it takes you to red basket, if it gives you above 5 then next go pick a red, pink, purple or brown gnome (for more points)  If it gives you less than 5 mushrooms pick the other colour group so pick, yellow, green, blue or orange.
